semantic.justification: Original private ImpEditEngine::CreateTextObject member-body extraction operates only the actual receiver and existing EditDoc, selection, pool, content, attributes, styles, WrongList, ParaPortion, TextPortion and EditLine owners. It preserves by-value selection adjustment, global whole-paragraph eligibility, actual DEF_METRIC/orientation/script metadata, destination-pool copies, empty-paragraph attributes, clipping, spell cloning, source cache conjunction and unsigned16 count narrowing, TextPortion copy/EditLine Clone behavior and exception cleanup. No second engine/state object, synthetic line model, default provider or renderer is introduced. CALC-439/440 preserve source narrowing and zero-count range behavior. The source no-view replacement and insertion preserve paragraph defaults, actual character features, source metric conversion, field refresh and text orientation. Full style-pool lookup, layout cache replay and interactive insertion remain outside the document editor slice.
